basics.name: Tim Jacobs
basics.label: Senior/Staff Software Engineer | Data, AI & Platform Architecture
basics.summary: Staff Software Engineer with deep expertise in large-scale data platforms, LLM-powered retrieval systems (RAG), and cloud-native infrastructure. Proven architect of event-driven pipelines, vector search applications, and shared platform components that power data-intensive products. 15+ years building high-leverage backend systems from storage validation to distributed AI services. Seeking to apply this experience to mission-critical domains where technical excellence drives positive human impact.

work.summary: Data platform & AI systems architecture for cross-platform content intelligence.
highlights: Architected and deployed an internal RAG-based data-quality tool using Snowflake Cortex for LLM inference, custom tokenization and vectorization pipelines, and k-NN/embedding similarity search to surface AI-generated taxonomy mappings.
Built a Streamlit review interface so the data quality team can inspect, validate, and accept AI recommendations produced by the RAG pipeline.
Implemented medallion architecture on Snowflake-based data pipelines to ingest and process trillions of rows of cross-platform data, supporting 20+ enterprise partners.

Engineered a hypernormalized metadata management system that standardized fragmented data from dozens of sources into a single canonical schema, achieving 80% coverage of all monthly events and eliminating manual mapping bottlenecks.

work.summary: Full-stack platform engineering, quality-focused technical leadership, and operational data architecture.
highlights: Architected and deployed 40+ shared platform components consumed by multiple engineering teams; reduced time-to-market for new features by 50% and improved code reuse across the organization.
Led technical design of CI/CD pipeline modernization; improved deployment velocity by 3x, reduced mean time to recovery by 60%, and enabled 200+ deployments per week.
Designed comprehensive test architecture for an event-driven billing service; enabled continuous deployment across 8+ microservices-based systems with 99.9% reliability.
Led operational data team; designed and implemented reference data re-architecture using event-driven ETL; reduced mean commit-to-deploy time from weeks to hours, increasing release velocity by 3x.

Developed scalable test automation framework for microservices in Python/Golang using AWS Lambda, S3, and SQS; automated 90% of previously manual test execution, reducing test cycle time from 6 hours to 12 minutes.
Mentored 6 junior engineers on microservices patterns, testing strategy, and AWS cloud best practices; 3 engineers promoted during tenure.

work.summary: Platform architecture, DevOps transformation, and test infrastructure leadership.
highlights: Designed and led a test result reporting platform from concept to production; engineered a queryable database with 2M+ daily test records and automated management dashboards, eliminating 40+ hours per week of manual reporting.

Spearheaded a DevOps transformation initiative with cross-functional stakeholders; reduced build failure rate by 50%, improved deployment reliability by 35%, and decreased infrastructure costs by $500K+ per year.

Architected a containerized test framework enabling migration of 1,000+ test cases from legacy systems to modern CI-driven infrastructure; reduced test execution time by 70% and improved reproducibility.

work.summary: Validation leadership, data-driven operations, and team management (4 direct reports).
highlights: Managed a team of 4 engineers validating enterprise/data center SAS/SATA SSDs across 4 Tier-1 OEM partners; maintained >$60M quarterly revenue through rigorous, on-time qualification processes.

Designed and deployed a qualification test status database with automated test script integration; eliminated manual reporting, enabled real-time visibility into validation progress, and reduced management reporting overhead by 30 hours per week.
Led a complete automation rewrite to meet compatibility team requirements; reduced deployment schedule by 20 months, improving test execution efficiency by orders of magnitude.
